description: Diagnostic-only audit of the proton 544k ppb defect.  Documents that the placeholder literals M_HECKE_PIPELINE_AT_Q0['p']=1.4283 and ['e']=0.0007783 in derivation_chain.py:73-76 give a Hecke ratio matching (m_p - m_e)/m_e to ~470 ppb, NOT m_p/m_e.  The 544,145 ppb error in proton-mass-50dps.derivation.json is structurally the missing electron-rest anchor.  This audit does NOT apply a fix: a `+1` patch on the Hecke ratio would hit CODATA by algebraic cancellation but would be fitting, not derivation.  Resolution options enumerated in docs/audits/2026-05-09-proton-m_e-anomaly.md (Options A-E).  Recommended: D (relabel-then-derive) or E (defer and focus 1ppb work on T1 / binding-energy chains that don't consume these placeholders).

data.finding: Hecke ratio sits at (m_p - m_e)/m_e to ~470 ppb. Not a Phi_q precision issue, not a convention bug, not a q_0 drift. Placeholders calibrated to wrong target (or upstream missing rest-mass anchor). NO FIX APPLIED.

resolution_options.A_relabel_only: Demote chain step to PLACEHOLDER; flag literals' provenance
resolution_options.B_recompute_from_6term: Assemble m_p from mass-formula-6term-mpfr-50dps witness; needs unit reconciliation + A=1 brane-tower extension + T5 sign audit + T6 unit clarification
resolution_options.C_audit_upstream_provenance: Find or refute the claimed 'rounded summary' upstream for 1.4283 / 0.0007783
resolution_options.D_recommended_A_then_B: Two-PR sequence: relabel first, then derive
resolution_options.E_defer: Treat 544k ppb as known-floor; focus 1ppb work on T1 / binding-energy chains that don't consume these literals
